newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain private consumption improved in Apr-May.
newsitem.headline: Spain private consumption improved in Apr-May.

text.p: Spanish private consumption continued growing in April and May, suggesting a pick-up in the different components of domestic demand, the Bank of Spain said on Wednesday.
"Private consumption indicators continued improving in April and May," according to the Bank of Spain's June bulletin, published today.

Private consumption rose 2.8 percent year-on-year in the first quarter from a revised 2.4 percent (originally 2.1 percent rate) in the last quarter of 1996, national statistics institute (INE) data showed.

"(In May) consumer confidence indicators strengthened on an improvement shown to April, with a particular improvement of opinions on economic performance and the appropriateness of buying durable goods," tha Bank of Spain said.
